summary: New Mountain Net Lease Trust, a Maryland REIT, filed an 8-K on October 15, 2026, disclosing a Purchase Agreement to acquire 100% of the assets of New Mountain Net Lease Partners II, L.P., an affiliated private vehicle managed by an affiliate of its investment adviser, for approximately $2.4 billion gross. The portfolio spans over 18 million square feet, 180 single-tenant industrial net-lease properties, 39 tenants, roughly 15-year weighted average lease term and 2.6% annual escalators. Consideration is cash, assumed debt and/or shares; $24 million (1.0%) escrow due October 22, 2026; diligence period to November 29, 2026.
